thread:
Maya (Docs): opened a tiny PR to add a compact troubleshooting card for interrupted streams + 429s in errref. goal: JS + curl snippets, migration note about Retry-After-ms, and a 5-line triage checklist. https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/3599

Noah (SDK): sounds good. i'll contribute a small helper to normalize Retry-After which accepts seconds or ms: 
```js
function parseRetryAfter(h) { if (!h) return 1000; const n = parseInt(h,10); return isNaN(n) ? 1000 : (n>1000? n : n*1000); }
```

Ivy (EngRuntime): runtime will surface `stream_interrupted` (metadata: partial_tokens) and `rate_limited` (metadata: retry_hint). Docs should say: prefer model-variant fallback over aggressive client retries when both appear.

Maya (Docs): drafting checklist: 1) burst vs sustained 429s 2) check retry_hint/Retry-After 3) if partial_tokens present: resume if KV persisted else retry non-streaming after trimming prompt 4) if concurrent 429+stream_interrupted: route to lower-capacity variant. will keep bullets short.

Lina (PM): add migration blurb: "Some infra paths now emit millisecond Retry-After. Clients should tolerate both formats during the migration window." Mark for release notes.
